conventions.convention: The prior is fixed independently of the training sample; a posterior is a probability measure absolutely continuous with respect to that prior.

Relative entropy is the supremum of divergences over finite measurable partitions. Zero-numerator terms are zero; positive numerator over zero denominator is infinite. Infinite relative entropy makes the risk bound vacuous.

The PAC-Bayes loss is jointly product-measurable and takes values in [0,C], including C=0. The sample has product law D^m with m≥1. The positive tuning parameter is fixed before observing the sample; the event controls every absolutely continuous posterior simultaneously and bounds posterior-average risk.
The tuning grid is a nonempty finite subset of the positive reals fixed independently of the sample; its simultaneous bound pays log(N/δ).

Compression selects at most d indices, including the empty subset, and supplies their labeled entries in increasing index order. Reconstruction is jointly measurable, uses no other side information, and need not lie in the concept class. Consistency is required on every target-labeled sample.
Compression sizes include d=0; the generalization theorem requires m>d and ε∈(0,1), and failure means risk strictly greater than ε.
Natural numbers and binomial counts in real expressions denote their canonical real images; e=exp(1).

load_bearing.statement: For a sample-independent prior π, product-measurable loss ℓ:Θ×Z→[0,C], an IID sample of size m≥1, fixed λ>0 and δ∈(0,1), with probability at least 1−δ, simultaneously for every probability measure ρ≪π: EρR ≤ EρR̂S + λC²/(8m) + (KL(ρ‖π)+log(1/δ))/λ. Infinite relative entropy makes the bound vacuous.

For a fixed measurable binary target, IID instance sample with law D^m, fixed jointly measurable reconstructors G0,…,Gd, m>d, and ε∈(0,1), the measurable event that some index subset I of size at most d reconstructs a classifier consistent on all m observations and of risk greater than ε has probability at most Σ(i=0,…,d) binom(m,i)(1−ε)^(m−i).
For probability measures π and ρ on a measurable space with ρ≪π, and every bounded measurable real function f, Eρf ≤ KL(ρ‖π)+log Eπexp(f), with the inequality vacuous when KL(ρ‖π)=∞.

A deterministic size-at-most-d sample-compression scheme consists of measurable index-selection maps for every natural sample length and fixed jointly measurable reconstruction maps using only the selected labeled entries in their sample order; consistency means reconstructing every label of every sample labeled by a concept in the specified class.

A prior is a probability measure fixed independently of the training sample. A posterior relative to it is an absolutely continuous probability measure. Their relative entropy is the supremum of finite measurable partition divergences with the stated zero and infinity conventions.
For natural numbers m,d with 1≤d≤m, Σ(i=0,…,d) binom(m,i) ≤ (em/d)^d.

seams_checked.note: Read the supplier page and def-supervised-learning-problem, def-population-and-empirical-risk, and lem-population-and-empirical-risk-are-measurable, including the lemma's proof. Comparing consumer uses back to their exact interfaces, binary compression satisfies the supervised measurable-space and loss conventions. Conversely, the parameter-indexed PAC-Bayes theorem does not infer joint measurability from the fixed-predictor lemma: it explicitly assumes a product-measurable parameterized loss and supplies the additional Tonelli argument. No independence or finite-risk hypothesis is incorrectly imported from the supplier definitions.
